objective: Purchase Xorothian Stardust from Ur'dan.  Bring it to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

description: So you come to me seeking Xorothian stardust?  You wish to open a portal to Xoroth, the domain of Hel'nurath my rival?  Perhaps you plan to steal from him one of his precious dreadsteeds?
Very well.  My servant Ur'dan has a supply of Xorothian stardust.  You may obtain it from him... if you can pay the price.
progress: Have you been to Jaedenar, <name>? Did you get the stardust from Lord Banehollow?
completion: There it is! I can hardly believe you got it! You must have struck a big deal with that Dreadlord or else paid a large sum, or both!
Mor'zul will have his ink very soon and then he can finally make the glyph parchment, so you can open a portal to Xoroth and pull through it one of the famed dreadsteeds!
